races.title: State House, District 81
races.note: The top two finishers from the Nov 3, 2026 count. Everyone else in this race is coming.

cands.name: Larry W. Potts
cands.bio: Republican state representative for North Carolina House District 81 since January 2017. Born in Davidson County. Air Force veteran. Owner and president of Southland Construction Company in Reeds. Previously a Davidson County commissioner for five non-consecutive terms, serving as board chairman for nine non-consecutive terms.

endorsements.text: His campaign site displays a banner saying he won NRA, NFIB and NC Right to Life endorsements. The site does not give the election year.

In 2016, his endorsers included the National Rifle Association, Lexington Mayor Newell Clark, Midway Mayor John Byrum, District Attorney Garry W. Frank, and Davidson County Register of Deeds David T. Rickard.

cands.gaps: We did not find any bills he sponsored, since the sponsored-legislation table on his Ballotpedia page was empty. We found no statements from him on data centers, homestead property taxes, land ownership, development or growth, immigration or H-1B, police pay, gun law, abortion or school choice. He has not completed Ballotpedia's candidate survey in recent cycles. We did not confirm where he was raised or when his adult residency in North Carolina began. We found no documented controversies or foreign ties in the pages reviewed. We also did not find the year of his NRA, NFIB and NC Right to Life endorsements.

local.label: Roots 55: He was born in Davidson County and has lived in the Reeds community there as an adult; he served on the county Board of Social Services for 19 consecutive years and on the county commission for multiple terms before 2017. His upbringing is not stated.

score.why: Raised $0, under $5,000 for this office: too little money to score fairly.

qual.background: Has served in the NC House since 2017 and was a Davidson County commissioner for five non-consecutive terms, including nine non-consecutive terms as chairman. He owns Southland Construction Company and is president of Davidson Investment Group.
qual.why: Nine years of prior legislative service plus long local elected office and business ownership fit the high band for writing law and the state budget. Committee chair roles were not counted.
qual.label: Nine years of prior legislative service plus long local elected office and business ownership fit the high band for writing law and the state budget. Committee chair roles were not counted.

cands.name: Dylan R. Tucker
cands.bio: Democratic candidate for North Carolina House District 81 in 2026. He advanced from a canceled primary and lost the general election to incumbent Larry Potts (R). The sources available give no occupation or offices held.

endorsements.text: Listed on Ballotpedia as recommended by two voter-guide groups, both run through the Sway app: Unburdening The Ballot: Voting Made Easy (Tevin 'Momala' Davis) and Waves of Democracy (Terri Robinson).

cands.gaps: We could not find his birthplace, where he grew up, when he came to North Carolina, or his occupation and work history. He did not complete Ballotpedia's 2026 candidate survey, and we found no campaign website statements, interviews or questionnaires. As a result, we have no record of his positions on data centers, property taxes, land ownership, growth, immigration, policing, guns, abortion or schools. We found no documented land-use or development statements, controversies or foreign ties, and no record of any elected office held.
